summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting treasury share purchases from June 1-5, 2026 as part of a second tranche buyback program approved by shareholders on May 6, 2026. The company acquired 4,311,291 shares (0.14% of capital) at a weighted average price of €23.1949/share, total consideration €99,999,945.45. The buyback aims to provide additional remuneration to shareholders beyond dividends. Since program start on May 8, 2026, Eni bought 11,182,647 shares (0.37% of capital) for €259,916,527.52, now holding 3.24% of share capital. This routine buyback execution presents no risk-arb angle; watch for continued program pace and potential accretion.
